response.sql: SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
